notes.title: [Jelly In The Dark] Update
notes.content:
We fixed issues that some achivements aren't completed properly.

1. Shopper Holic (Not completed even you bought all items)
2. Rich Jelly (Not completed if you earned 1000 honey through slot machine game)

notes.title: [Jelly In The Dark] Update
notes.content:
We fixed some parts for more smooth game play.

- You can retry potion making game.
- The bounty hunter ant will not appear after multiple tries of roulette.
- Collected Ending UI is added to the "Ending Guide".

notes.title: [Full Release] Jelly in the Dark is released!
notes.content:
Jelly in the Dark is full released! 

More content has been added for a smoother and more fun game!
 
- Added prologue for abundant storytelling
- Added quest system for smooth progress
- Added bounty hunter ant for thrilling games
- Applied capability to the equipments (additional moving speed)


Improved existing systems more intuitively!

- Added Ending Collection Gathering View
- Added item acquisition message and UI
- Improved character animation


Find the developer's little Easter Egg!
